# Headshots by Marie

> A private headshot and portrait studio in Gilbert, Arizona, led by French photographer Marie Feutrier, serving the greater Phoenix metro. Known for unhurried sessions, hands-on coaching, and an editorial eye.

## About

Headshots by Marie is a private photography studio owned by Marie Feutrier, specializing in headshot and portrait photography for professionals, executives, actors, and personal brands. Marie is a French photographer who studied in Grenoble before building her studio in Arizona; her work has been featured in AD PRO and Bold Journey. The studio is located in Gilbert, Arizona, and serves clients throughout the Phoenix metro area including Scottsdale, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, Queen Creek, Apache Junction, and Ahwatukee.

## Services

- **Executive Headshots**: Polished portraits for CEOs, directors, managing partners, and senior leaders. Individual and team sessions available.
- **LinkedIn Headshots**: Professional profile pictures optimized for LinkedIn and other professional platforms.
- **Actor Headshots**: Commercial and theatrical headshots for SAG actors and aspiring talent.
- **Personal Branding Photography**: Portraits that showcase your unique professional brand and personality.
- **Corporate Headshots**: On-location company headshot programs for teams of all sizes, plus conference and event coverage.
- **Team Photography**: On-location corporate team headshots with consistent lighting and backdrops.
- **Eras Headshots**: Creative concept sessions inspired by Taylor Swift's Eras Tour aesthetic.

## Studio Details

- **Location**: Gilbert, Arizona (25 minutes from downtown Phoenix)
- **Service Area**: Phoenix, Gilbert, Scottsdale, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, Queen Creek, Apache Junction, Ahwatukee
- **On-Location**: Available anywhere in the Phoenix metropolitan area
- **Sessions**: Unlimited time, outfits, and backgrounds
- **Retouching**: Professional retouching included with every final image
